title: ID0454887-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 170000974] Sim Card Issue
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: Sim Card Issue
Solution: informed RC/FST to perform the following troubleshooting: correct insertion of SIM card, verification of stable network connection, reset router via system. if issue perform factory reset. if none of these troubleshooting succeed, replace router
8EM5903-0AA05-7AA5 – Router Ethernet Mobile (4G) RUT241

additional_info.body:
Dear Simen,
Please follow the troubleshooting steps described below.
Customer:

Main Asset:

Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
S
orry for my previous email. Please disregard this information.
Please consider the following troubleshooting steps in order to solve your issue with the SIM card issue.
Please perform the following checks:
Ensure the SIM card is correctly inserted.
Verify that the network connection is stable.
Before requesting a router replacement, please try the following:
First, attempt to reset the router to its default settings via the
System
tab in the router interface.
If that does not resolve the issue, perform a
factory reset
using the button located on the back of the router.
If the issue persists after these steps, proceed with replacing the router.
We will provide you with all necessary details for the required router model for this charger:
8EM5903-0AA05-7AA5 – Router Ethernet Mobile (4G) RUT241
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-NO SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Philippe Ribeiro
